purpose: OCG native desktop GUI concepts for visual comparison; illustrative data, not implemented runtime screenshots.

variants.label: A · 轻盈概览
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished high fidelity UI concept image of OCG / Open Console Gateway, a native Rust desktop application built using Ely components and GPUI. This is an actual desktop application interface screenshot, flat front-on, not a webpage, not a promotional poster, no device mockup, no desk backdrop. Landscape canvas approximately 1600x1000 / 16:10. One complete application window fills the image with small neutral cross-platform desktop title bar and subtle window controls. No browser address bar or browser tabs. All product UI text is in precise simplified Chinese with only provider names and OCG/Plan/Key in Latin. Legible well spaced Chinese typography akin Source Han Sans, numbers tabular. Include coherent icons, aligned UI, elegant restrained design, realistic interactive controls. Native custom-drawn components, modest corner radii, no glassmorphism, no decorative gradients, no neon, no giant marketing headings. Product scope: local AI gateway management with Plans, provider accounts, public models, client access Keys, trusted quota evidence, logs, settings. Main navigation uses exactly 总览, Plans, 账号, 模型, Keys, 日志, 设置. Gateway currently running, shown with green dot and 运行中, local connection and 控制台已连接; show 停止网关 as a small secondary action. No billing, prices, cost estimates, token-wallet budgets, AI chat, agent workflow, remote fleet or node synchronization. Sample Plan names OpenAI Team, Claude Pro, Gemini; illustrative statuses 可用, 暂时不可用, 未知. Quota must be remaining official window allowance, never a local token-spending estimate; show 未知 for missing evidence, don't portray every provider as reporting precise quota. Include a discreet footer reading 示意数据. Highly finished product design with realistic information density. No narrative explanation, no annotations outside the app, no collage.
Design version A: light airy overview. Calm Ely-inspired light surfaces #FAFAF7, slightly warm gray sidebar #F0F1ED, deep gray typography #25312F, muted jade #367765 used for successful states and primary action, hairline gray #DDE3DF. Font hierarchy restrained, no serif. Layout: left fixed navigation rail 205px, spacious overview canvas. Native titlebar OCG at top left. Main heading 总览 with a small freshness label 刚刚更新. A single broad gateway status strip beneath heading, with 本地网关 on left, 运行中 and 控制台已连接, and 停止网关 on right. Main dominant section 我的 Plans: three broad horizontal rows, NOT identical KPI cards. Each row has provider icon, Plan title, account sublabel, status and one or two compact quota progress tracks or explicit unknown. OpenAI Team shows 5小时窗口, 剩余 62%, 18:40 恢复; Claude Pro shows 额度未知 with 查看详情; Gemini shows 连接正常 and 官方额度未提供. Small action 添加 Plan beside section heading. Beneath, recent request activity table labeled 最近请求, columns 时间, 模型, Plan, 结果, 耗时 with a few aligned entries gpt-5, claude-sonnet, gemini-pro, 200, 429 and restrained green/amber status. A slim right-side secondary column contains 需要处理 with one clear amber entry Claude Pro 暂时不可用, 查看原因, followed by connection information 本地连接 and 复制连接信息. Prioritize breathing room and clear readable aligned rows; few boxes, avoid a grid of summary number cards. Do not invent overall precise total quota.

Design version B: professional graphite dark management workbench. Distinct structure and density from the other variants, understated and calm like a serious native database tool. Colors #24272B main, #1E2125 rail, #2D3238 selected and panel surfaces, #E3E7EB main text, #9DA7B0 secondary, muted blue #80A4C1 for selected UI; green #88B49B and amber #D5B47F only semantic. Absolutely no neon glow or gradients. Small sidebar 175px with Plans selected. Top application status is a narrow bottom statusbar reading 本地网关 运行中 and 控制台已连接. Main page heading Plans at upper left and compact toolbar 添加 Plan, 刷新状态. Under it a search field 搜索 Plan 或账号, filter 状态: 全部 and small 按供应商分组 control. Large dense but legible table consumes left 70% of main area, separate permanent inspector occupies right 30%, with vertical hairline divider. Table columns Plan, 供应商, 状态, 额度, 恢复时间, 账号. Six rows, three distinct Plan families and distinct account aliases, realistic: OpenAI Team / OpenAI / 可用 / 62% /18:40/工作账号; OpenAI Personal /OpenAI/可用/未知/—/个人账号; Claude Pro /Anthropic/暂时不可用/未知/18:55/写作账号; Gemini /Google/可用/未知/—/备用账号; Test API /API/已停用/未知/—/测试账号; OpenAI Backup /OpenAI/可用/38%/周日/备用账号. Selected first row softly highlighted blue-gray. Header checkbox and row checkboxes plus kebab menus. Inspector heading OpenAI Team, subheading 工作账号, compact status 可用, tabs 详情 and 额度, aligned fields 登录方式 OAuth, 状态 已连接, 最近刷新 2分钟前, button 刷新状态. Show quota remaining 5小时窗口 62% with progress bar and 18:40 恢复; compact 模型范围 listing gpt-5 and gpt-5-mini. Inspector bottom 编辑 Plan as primary and 停用 as secondary. Display operational data prominently, native table text at legible size, not terminal screenshot, no huge metric cards. Bottom strip shows 最近操作 with 配置已保存, graceful understated feedback.

Design version C: light slate-green master-detail Plan management, sophisticated composed native desktop app. Colors near-white #F7FAF9 main, slate-green #E8EFED sidebar, dark ink #233B37, subdued teal #477E77, selected pale teal #DDEDE8, lines #D6E1DC. Clearly distinct from A's overview and B's dense dark table. Three columns: narrow 72px icon navigation rail with icon plus short Chinese labels; Plan list pane 285px; large right detail canvas. Header title Plans over list and small + 添加 button with search 搜索 Plan. List has thoughtful provider grouping OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and five entries with account aliases and minimal colored dot statuses. OpenAI Team selected. Main detail heading OpenAI Team with 工作账号 underneath, small status 可用, aligned buttons 刷新额度 and 编辑 at top right. Beneath a compact tab row 概览, 额度, 账号, 模型 with 额度 active. Central dominant section 额度窗口 uses two large but calm horizontally aligned rectangular sections with flat surfaces: 5小时窗口, 剩余 62%, a horizontal track with 62% remaining clearly stated, 18:40 恢复; 7天窗口, 剩余 38%, second aligned track and 周日恢复. Below them a thin full-width evidence strip 官方额度数据 / 2分钟前更新 with 查看来源 and no economic or token-spending estimates. Beneath, an ordered 恢复时间 section uses a modest time axis with now labeled 现在 and first time point 18:40, showing current window remaining and reset, NOT a speculative usage forecast graph. Lower right readable 关联账号 fields 登录方式 OAuth, 账号状态 已连接, small 查看账号 button. Lower left 最近状态 list showing 14:32 额度已刷新 and 14:20 登录有效. Footer gateway status reads 运行中 with small 停止网关. No ornamental chart, no widget explosion, focus on understanding one Plan and taking actions. Chinese text large enough to read. Emphasize refined alignment and clear visual hierarchy.

edits.a: Edit this OCG native desktop GUI concept screenshot with precise localized changes. Preserve all existing layout, sizes, colors, typography, controls, table, Plan rows and the overall look. This application has no web console. In the right-hand 连接信息 panel, keep only service connection information: first field label 服务地址 with value http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 and copy icon; replace the second field's 控制台 label and URL ending /console with 客户端 Key, value 已隐藏, and a small button 管理 Keys. Replace every 控制台已连接 in the image with 管理服务已连接. Remove the invented marketing slogan 连接真实的 AI 能力 at bottom left, leaving the OCG and Open Console Gateway branding. In the recent-request 时间 column replace dated timestamps with short clock-only times, e.g. 14:28:21, 14:27:08, 14:26:33, 14:25:17, 14:24:03. Ensure the amber status text is exactly 暂时不可用. Keep footer 示意数据. All other elements unchanged. Flat desktop screenshot; no browser chrome.
